purpose: Cross-pretrained-family replication of the actual trained explicit-state/query-execution repair. Not a native-only run.

model.revision_policy: Resolve the official repository once into MODEL_LOCK.json before rental; use the immutable SHA thereafter.

training.order: Original seed0_ORDER.json and seed1_ORDER.json sample-order lists
training.fallback_rule: Choose only from canary memory/throughput before protected inference; same for both seeds
training.loss: response-only Yes/No plus Gemma <end_of_turn>; exact chat-template boundary must yield two supervised tokens

scoring.first_token_margin: native post-softcap logit(Yes)-logit(No); verify actual single-token labels at the assistant boundary
scoring.candidate_mode: RAW original PPR/QSA1 contract, not READBACK or type filtering
scoring.renderer: Fold the exact system instruction into the first user message with two LF characters; use Gemma official chat template

endpoints.saved: No saved outcome is used as the fresh Gemma baseline

evaluation.primary_unit: complete post subject: every target AND every control correct across all four histories, full 128 denominator
evaluation.primary_codec: Unchanged PPR whole-response source-ID/name codec for every new generative endpoint; first-line sensitivity separately
evaluation.first_line_sensitivity: retain old SCALE first-line interpretation separately; never pick the favorable parser

bootstrap.unit: subject; all questions/histories and both seeds together

evaluation.repeat_scope: every current question under all six source conditions, separate process, no result cache; STATE_BASE and both trained scorers
evaluation.isolation: complete current input equality + independent uncached control agreement; never inferred from low witness count
evaluation.own_native_witnesses: All new Gemma guarded witnesses from all384 targets, frozen mechanically before repair-ledger analysis; W=0 is not an efficacy pass
evaluation.known_qwen9: Fixed cross-family challenge/preservation set, NOT nine Gemma failures by assumption

limits.preferred_gpu: Runpod Secure H100 SXM 80GB, subject to measured eager-training fit
limits.alternative: Runpod Secure H200 141GB only when measured complete forecast fits
limits.technical_replacements: Necessary technical replacements within unchanged original cumulative time/cost and one-live-GPU caps; never outcome-driven
limits.billing_credit_rule: Existing auto-refill is not a new approval or available-credit gate; cost is attributable usage, not deposits

claim_boundaries: Method/recipe transfer to a different pretrained family, not a parameter-matched causal size comparison
History separation does not depend on correct interpretation; end-to-end usefulness does
The same researcher-exposed retained128 subjects, not fresh questions
No normalized train overlap for384 targets or65K;33 F/decoy occurrences remain flagged
Fresh Gemma baselines; neither old Gemma9 failures nor Qwen32 failures substitute for new Gemma27 failures
Whole-system trained repair comparisons, not a pure data-structure causal effect
No raw-English-update guarantee or original native-editor F1-F4/fullR3 certification
No Olmo, new Gemma generation,9B substitution, QRT extension, tuning or automatic successor
